meta.method: ridge least squares on every completed game, solving offence, defence and home edge jointly, then shrunk by games played and blended with the closing line

backtest.history: 48.79% before the scale fix, 49.76% after scaling alone, 56.07% once the home-field term was anchored and the rescale centred on the market
backtest.verdict: above break-even by 3.7 points over 416 walk-forward games, the same in both seasons independently, and not concentrated on favourites, dogs, home or road. That is one and a half standard errors, so it is a promising result and not a proven edge. Most of it sits in games where the model barely disagrees with the line, which is not the shape a durable edge usually has. Bet it small or not at all until the live record says more.
